evals.name: nest-update-typer-crash
evals.precondition: nest update fails with "'Context' object has no attribute '_param_default_explicit'"
evals.expected_output: One agent-ready bug issue whose confirmed root cause is that NestCommand adds a standalone click.Option to commands whose Context comes from the click copy vendored in typer 0.26+, with the machine left as it was found.
expectations: Hygiene: the main checkout's HEAD, branches, stashes and `git status --short` are identical before and after the run.
Hygiene: `git worktree list` shows only the main checkout after the run.
Hygiene: user-level state is identical before and after the run: `uv tool list`, uv-managed Pythons, `~/.local/bin`, `~/.config/nest`, and the entries directly under the home directory.
Hygiene: nothing was pushed and no branch, pull request, release, or comment on another issue was created or changed on GitHub.
Process: the agent reproduced the reported crash by running Nest with the reporter's command before proposing a cause.
Process: scratch edits and program runs happened in a throwaway git worktree, not in the main checkout.
Process: the agent proved the cause with a scratch fix that turned a minimised reproduction from failing to passing, and reverted it afterwards.
Diagnosis: the stated root cause is that Nest builds an option with the standalone click package while typer 0.26+ creates the Context from its own vendored click copy.
Ticket: exactly one new issue exists, labelled `bug` plus exactly one of `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, or `needs-info`.

Ticket: the body begins with the triage AI disclaimer, followed by an `## Agent Brief` block with Category, Summary, Current behavior, Desired behavior, Key interfaces, Acceptance criteria, and Out of scope.
Ticket: the first acceptance criterion is a regression test written test-first that fails on this bug; the last is that the original reproduction passes.
Ticket: code is referenced by symbol; no Nest source file paths or line numbers appear outside quoted reproduction output.
Report: the final message gives the issue URL and a one-line root cause.
